messages:
sadia: Heads up — I'm seeing a sharp p99 per-token latency spike in the per-token SLO dashboard for us-west-2 starting ~12:10 PDT. Grafana alert fired.
infra-bot: ALERT: per_token_p99_ms > 800 for model=rwkv-small region=us-west-2 at 1782345678 (alert id: per-token-p99-usw2)
sadia: Tokens/sec drops at the same time the p99 jumps — looks like queueing. Screenshot attached in thread.
matt: I'm checking scheduler metrics now. One H100 pool in us-west-2 shows spikes in work_queued and ~3 preemptions in the last 5m.
olivia: Any config changes or deploys around 12:05-12:09?
jlee: I rolled a small batch_size tweak for the vanguard models at 12:08 to reduce memory pressure. It reduced memory usage but might have increased per-request overhead.
sadia: PromQL I'm eyeballing: ```
# tokens/sec per node
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_processed_total[1m])) by (node)

# p99 per-token latency by model/region
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region))
```
matt: Also correlating kube_events: saw node evictions and container preempted events on nodes in that nodepool. dmesg shows a couple of OOM kills around 12:09 on one worker.
olivia: Could network eBPF weirdness cause higher tail latency? Any indications in pod network retrans stats?
jlee: I don't see large RX/TX errors, more like CPU->GPU scheduling stalls. The affected nodes show high nv_peer_mem stall counters.
sadia: Short-term mitigation options: (1) divert a percentage of traffic for affected models to us-east-1 dedicated pool, (2) spin up one extra H100 replica group in us-west-2, (3) revert the batch_size tweak for vanguard models. Thoughts?
matt: Diverting traffic to us-east-1 is safest for immediate user impact; we have routing controls at the route level. I'll help with traffic percentage. Also low-friction: bump up per-node concurrency if the scheduler allows.
ojlee: (typo) jlee: I'll prepare a manual canary route and rollback plan. If we spin up more pods we should watch tokens/sec per GPU to avoid cost blowouts.
sadia: Adding cost signal: tokens_per_gpu and tokens_per_dollar panels should be visible on the SLO dashboard so we can weigh cost vs latency tradeoffs. Current tokens_per_gpu in us-west-2 dropped ~30% during the spike.
matt: For alert tuning: current static threshold 500ms p99 is noisy when load shifts. Recommend adaptive thresholding by model-family and by tokens/sec window, plus guardrail that alerts only if tokens/sec drop > 20% AND p99 > X.
sadia: I'll open a PR to: update Grafana buckets (p50/p95/p99), add tokens/sec-per-GPU panel, and change the alert condition to include a rate-of-change clause.

# Prometheus alert snippet I'm proposing:
```
ALERT PerTokenP99Spike
IF histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region)) > (label_replace(avg_over_time(per_token_adaptive_threshold[15m]), "", "", "", ""))
AND increase(redwood_tokens_processed_total[5m]) < (previous_window * 0.8)
FOR 2m
```

matt: I'll draft the adaptive threshold job (small service that emits per-model baseline). We can start with 99th-percentile baseline over trailing 7d.

jlee: Actions: 1) I'll spin up extra H100 group in us-west-2 (spin id: spin-178234) — ETA 25m. 2) Prepare route diversion to us-east-1 at 12:45 — manual canary 10%. 3) Revert batch_size tweak if spin/dive doesn't help.
olivia: I'll reset the alert to mute while we test and annotate the alert runbook.

infra-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: INCIDENT-2026-03-18-42, owner=sadia, severity=high, linked_alert=per-token-p99-usw2

sadia: Timeline plan: spin new pool by 12:40, divert up to 20% traffic by 12:45 if necessary, assess impact by 13:00. Postmortem draft by EOD.
matt: I'll update the Grafana dashboard link and runbook: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/slo/per-token (add example queries in runbook).
jlee: Spin started. posting k8s job logs: ```
kubectl -n inference scale deploy/h100-pool --replicas=6
```
sadia: Thanks — assigning owners in the incident doc: owner=sadia, routing=jlee, alert-tuning=matt, postmortem=olivia :thumbsup:
olivia: +1 :heavy_check_mark:
sadia: Closing loop: longer-term items — 1) make batch-size autosuggest workload-aware in Redwood Optimize, 2) add model-family adaptive p99 baselines, 3) add tokens-per-gpu cost panel to console. I'll file tickets after the incident.

matt: Noted. I'll start the PR for alert changes and share in #eng-sre for review.
sadia: Great work team — keep updates in this thread as actions complete. :heart:
